title: Preview upcoming repository brief delivery occurrences
request:
Operator-authored feature request, not a fetched GitHub issue: provide a read-only delivery schedule preview helper in Onionsoup. Export nextOccurrences(raw: DeliveryConfig, count: number, now = new Date()) from src/delivery/schedule.ts. Return exactly count chronological {key,dueAt} occurrences strictly after now, using the same local identities and first-instant DST-fold semantics as latestOccurrence/nextOccurrence. count must be an integer from 1 through 14; throw synchronously for invalid counts, invalid clocks and invalid configurations; error classes and messages are not part of this public contract. If the bounded horizon cannot supply count occurrences, throw synchronously rather than return a partial preview. Respect configured weekdays and time zone; skip spring-forward nonexistent minutes, including a weekly schedule whose next nominal day is skipped, and do not repeat the second instant of a folded minute even when now lies between the two instants. Preserve existing latestOccurrence/nextOccurrence behavior, do not mutate configuration or Date arguments, and bound the search (a 120-day future horizon is sufficient for supported weekly schedules). This helper performs no delivery, analysis, network or file effects; adding a UI or CLI is out of scope.
Append meaningful regression tests to test/delivery.test.ts, preserving every original byte and all existing imports; dynamic import inside new tests can access the new export. Include normal/weekday selection, DST gap and fold cases, and invalid input coverage. Document the public helper, count bounds, strict-future/DST rules and read-only meaning in docs/specs/scheduled-delivery.md. Only those three files may change; no dependencies or policy changes. Independent host acceptance tests and the complete selected delivery test file plus project typechecking run offline.
